purpose: Compare outer-frame treatments after the owner requested removing the vertical divider and raising Your response. These are full-screen concept previews, not engine textures.
generator: OpenAI built-in image generation via ChatGPT
shared_direction: One continuous parchment background behind unframed portrait and response list.
No internal divider, portrait border, separate rectangular backing or join fittings.
Your response ribbon raised onto the upper rail.
Same cabin composition, characters, multiline choices, selected second row and scrollbar.
production_note: After an option is selected, supply one continuous background plus an outer frame; composite the animated portrait over the panel. The previous aperture/divider-based production master and its geometry need replacement. No runtime implementation is included in this set.
copy_note: Preview response wording is layout content, not new screenplay.

variants.title: Slim walnut
variants.style: The closest refinement of the current design: warm worn walnut outer rails about 20 percent slimmer than the reference, four restrained rounded brass corner caps. Continuous quiet wood top and bottom. Softly rounded outer corners, small clear rivets, ample clean parchment. Reduce bulk while preserving the original wood-and-brass character.
variants.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / UI concept variation.
Input image is the approved pirate-cabin screenshot and the EDIT TARGET. Edit only the bottom dialogue UI as described. Preserve the whole room above it exactly: camera, composition, lighting, warm palette, Captain and chef character designs, fishbowl and Count Fingers. No new objects or modern fixtures. One full-screen 16:9 screenshot, same framing.

MANDATORY FOR THIS VARIATION:
1. REMOVE the vertical wooden divider between the portrait and response text completely, including both of its end joints. No vertical bar, line, trim, rope, seam, shadow, gap, or inner portrait border may replace it.
2. Use ONE continuous warm cream parchment interior across the entire width of the bottom panel, behind BOTH the portrait and the response text. Remove the separate dark red rectangular portrait backing. Captain Livé's existing head-and-shoulders portrait becomes an UNFRAMED cutout over this shared parchment background. Keep his recognizable black tricorn, red plume, curled mustache, expression and long chin exactly, same scale and same left-hand position. The face and hat stay within the outer frame. Do not draw any box or boundary around the portrait. The area where the old divider stood is simply uninterrupted parchment, joining seamlessly into the response background.
3. Move the red "Your response" ribbon UP about 16 pixels from the reference, so its top aligns with the top of the outer frame and it rests ON the top rail, as in the earlier header placement. Keep it at the same horizontal position near the start of the response list. Do not lower the header inside the body. All five options use this same raised header position.
4. Preserve the current overall bottom-panel footprint and its aligned top and bottom edges. Portrait and text share the same outer-frame height. Preserve text size, response positions, second-row selection, scrollbar, numbered circles, wrapping and space for scrolling.

Keep exact UI wording:
Your response
1 About this captive of yours.
2 What is in the pot?
3 Ask about the recipe.
4 Has Count Fingers been fed, or is he still planning to eat the crew?
5 Carry on.
The fourth response wraps onto two lines; the fifth may remain partially clipped at the viewport bottom. Do not invent additional dialogue. Keep the selected second response red and gold. Keep the right vertical scrollbar.

FRAME STYLE FOR THIS ONE IMAGE:
The closest refinement of the current design: warm worn walnut outer rails about 20 percent slimmer than the reference, four restrained rounded brass corner caps. Continuous quiet wood top and bottom. Softly rounded outer corners, small clear rivets, ample clean parchment. Reduce bulk while preserving the original wood-and-brass character.
Keep the frame clearly related to the approved warm, worn, cartoony pirate-game UI. Ornament belongs ONLY to the OUTSIDE perimeter, never between portrait and text. No new large crests, skulls, logos, emblems, extra panels, captions or variant labels. This is a modest variation of the same approved interface, not a redesigned screen. Output exactly one screenshot.

variants.title: Fine brass inlay
variants.style: Warm dark walnut outer rails with a single thin continuous antique-brass line inset around the perimeter. NO bulky brass corner plates: use clean small clipped/bevelled outer corners with the brass inlay turning neatly through them. Subtle worn gold against dark brown, a slightly more elegant and precise captain's writing-desk finish. This option must visibly differ from the big-corner-cap version while keeping the same footprint and parchment interior.

variants.title: Rope-edged walnut
variants.style: Warm walnut perimeter edged with ONE thin restrained twisted hemp rope around the OUTSIDE border. Rope follows the straight long rails and rounds the four external corners, with tiny brass binding clamps at the corners. The overall border remains compact. No big knots, loops, coils or rope across the interior. A simple nautical variation, keeping the rope texture coarse enough to read at this scale and the inner parchment entirely clear.
